business_problem: With the soccer World Cup approaching in 2022, needed a cost-effective way to be able to support demand spikes for betting on this and other major sporting events. When its customer growth took off, KTO.com needed to expand and optimize its infrastructure to maintain a good customer experience.
solution_summary: KTO.com provides an online sports betting and casino games platform for the Latin America market. Having built its platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS) from the beginning, turned to the cloud provider to help it deal with growth. Opportunity: Migrating for Improved Performance and Personalization The company chose AWS because of its diverse range of services. KTO.com worked with AWS Partner 56Bit to plan and implement the changes to its platforms. Jonathan Bonett Chief Technical Officer Solution: Pre-Scheduling Infrastructure Scaling Using AWS Lambda and Amazon EC2 Non-technical employees at KTO.com can now scale compute resources using a simple scheduler, which lets them set the day and time for coming events that will increase betting volumes.
